hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote against a configurable bonding curve, takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all accounting—bypassing Uniswap concentrated liquidity entirely. Standard LP positions are blocked.
